prompt_text: Who is the best digital marketing agency in St. Louis?
answer_verbatim:
There’s no single “best” agency — the right one depends on your goals, budget, industry, and whether you need SEO, PPC, social, content, web design, or a full-service partner. I can help you find the best fit. Quick plan and questions:

1) Quick questions so I can recommend specific agencies:
- What are your top goals? (more leads, e‑commerce sales, brand awareness, app installs, etc.)
- Which services do you need? (SEO, paid search, social ads, content, web dev, analytics, CRO, email)
- Monthly budget range (ballpark)?
- Preferred agency size or model? (small local shop, boutique specialist, national/enterprise)
- Any timeline or industry preference (B2B, healthcare, retail, hospitality)?

2) How I’ll evaluate agencies for you:
- Relevant case studies and measurable results
- Client references and retention
- Industry experience
- Pricing model and minimums
- Reporting cadence and tools
- Team structure and who will actually work on your account

3) If you want to search yourself, good sources:
- Clutch.co and UpCity for verified reviews and filters
- Google Maps / Google Business listings + reviews
- St. Louis Business Journal / Ad Club of St. Louis award lists
- LinkedIn company pages and team bios

Tell me the answers to the questions above (or say “just find top-rated full-service agencies”), and I’ll shortlist 4–6 St. Louis agencies that match your needs with quick pros/cons and next-step talking points.
session_note: run_channel caveat: API results can differ from logged-in consumer apps, no memory, no personalization.
